messages:
maya: Heads-up — prototyping a tiny UX for quick per-route analytics bookmarks in Console. idea: a keyboard shortcut to open saved filters/bookmarks that can apply to route OR route+model. thoughts?
sam: Love that. Important question: saved scope — do we treat route vs model as separate saved objects or a single saved query with optional model_id?
kevin: Also need RBAC rules. saved queries should only show what team/role can see. and audit/logging for who created/applied them.
maya: thinking single saved object with optional model_id. metadata: owner, visibility (personal/team/org), created_at, filters, time_range, pinned boolean. quick apply should not override a user-specified model pin unless explicitly requested.
liz: Can you drop a mock or quick sketch? also: keyboard shortcut idea — what if we use ":bookmark" quick palette instead of a single key to avoid conflicts?
maya: yep, mock incoming. rough config example to show shape: ```json
{
  "id": "bk_20240315_01",
  "name": "high-latency-routes - last 24h",
  "scope": "team:infra",
  "route_id": "route_87a",
  "model_id": "gptj-6b-v2",
  "filters": [{"field":"p50_latency_ms","op":">","value":200}],
  "time_range": "24h",
  "pinned": true
}
```
sam: Nice. UX nit: when you apply, we should show a small toast with an "Apply & pin model" toggle. many routes have multi-model fallbacks. user should be able to opt-in to pin model in the query.
kevin: +1. Also consider quotas telemetry: when a bookmarked query contains a heavy time range, warn about the cost and show estimated token/scan count. maybe inline cost delta before applying.
liz: For sharing: add copy-link that encodes the saved query id and optional ephemeral token so people can share an ephemeral view without granting full visibility. display owner and last-run stats next to each bookmark.
ops-bot: feature-flag update: console.quick_bookmarks = rollout:50% (teams:infra,product) — installed toggle at 2024-03-15 16:02Z
maya: good call on cost preview. i'll add an estimate field to the saved object and a quick modal that runs a cheap cardinality sample to show expected rows/cost.
sam: thinking ahead: we might want a "pin to route page" CTA so the route detail header shows 3 suggested bookmarks (auto-ranked by recency/use).
kevin: don't forget evals/rollouts tie-in: if a bookmark references a model version that gets rolled back, show fallback notice and which version was live when bookmark created.
liz: UI: show ownership and visibility chips, and allow bulk actions (delete, change scope) for team admins. keyboard palette: type ">book" to show results quickly.
maya: awesome. i'll put a short RFC in product-docs and drop the figma link once mockups ready. will also add an API stub for saved queries so eng-platform can review. thanks all :thumbsup:
